ideas.name: SK Hynix Inc. (Nasdaq ADR)
ideas.thesis: SKHY appeared in all 6 of 6 overnight screens with unanimous high conviction — the strongest signal in today's digest. SK Hynix controls ~57% of the global HBM memory market, the highest-demand segment in AI infrastructure, with EPS +103-104% YoY last quarter and a 40 trillion won buyback active. A Reuters-reported Intel/US foundry partnership negotiation (Sep 16) triggered a 4% single-day rally, layered on top of a BofA price target raise to $268 (from $250, Sep 14) and a JPMorgan Overweight initiation (Sep 9), creating a rare multi-catalyst stacking event.
ideas.catalyst: Reuters Intel/US foundry partnership talks (Sep 16); Q3 2026 earnings expected ~Oct 2026; DRAM shortage pricing tailwind ongoing
ideas.edge: Stock pulled back to ~$175-180 from $199 high, creating a ~$88 gap to BofA's $268 target and ~75% gap to WallStreetZen consensus target of $252; net income +108% YoY; 57% HBM market share in the fastest-growing semiconductor segment
ideas.bull_case: Intel partnership deal confirmation would be a structural re-rating event; HBM pricing power + DRAM shortage tailwind + $268 BofA target gives a clear multi-month runway, and Q3 earnings in Oct could be another positive surprise.
ideas.bear_case: Intel deal talks may not materialize or could face US export/geopolitical friction; ADR options liquidity may be limited — verify before sizing; a second Fed hike Oct 28 could pressure high-multiple growth names broadly.

ideas.name: NVIDIA Corporation
ideas.thesis: NVDA appeared in all 6 of 6 overnight screens (5 high conviction, 1 medium) and is the clearest AI infrastructure beneficiary in today's tape. ideas.catalyst: Post-Q2 earnings bullish momentum ongoing; next earnings ~Nov 2026 (FQ3 FY2027); FOMC Oct 27-28 as binary macro pivot

ideas.bear_case: 10-year yield at 4.93% and a Kalshi-implied 50.5% chance of an Oct hike create real multiple compression risk; stock is only +2% YTD vs. market +7%, suggesting the market is already pricing in some macro drag.
